title: Three Arms and One Plate: The Delta Robot, Its Closed Form Both Ways, and Why It Is So Fast

questions.question: What keeps a delta's platform from tilting?
options: The parallelograms of rods
A fourth motor in the middle
The weight of the platform itself
A controller that corrects the tilt it measures
questions.explanation: Each arm is joined to the platform by a pair of equal rods. A parallelogram keeps its two ends parallel, and three of them leave the platform free to move but not to tilt.

questions.question: How is each arm solved?
options: All three together, as six equations
On its own, in its own frame, as two circles meeting
By Newton's iteration from the last pose
By a search over the motor angles
questions.explanation: The platform does not tilt, so turning the target by 120 degrees for each arm gives three copies of one plane problem with a closed answer.

questions.question: At -0.40 m the reach was:
options: 0.460 m, the length of the rods
0.120 m, the radius of the base
The same at every height
0.310 m out from the axis
questions.explanation: The reach is widest part way down and narrows below, a dome and not a box. At -0.40 m it was 0.310 m from the axis.

questions.question: The moving parts weighed:
options: 18 kg, as for any arm of that reach
7.8 kg
0.78 kg, against 18 for a six axis arm
0.20 kg, the platform alone
questions.explanation: The motors are fixed to the base and only the arms, rods and platform move. With the same torque that is many times the acceleration.

questions.question: What is a delta for?
options: Heavy parts moved slowly
Work that needs the tool tilted
A large table of boxes
Fast, light pick and place from above
questions.explanation: It trades reach and payload for speed, and its platform stays level. That is small parts taken from a belt at a high rate.

questions.question: What is not checked here?
options: That the forward kinematics returns the pose asked for
The rods colliding and the limits of their ball joints
That each arm is solved in its own frame
That a point out of reach is refused
questions.explanation: The geometry is of ideal rods and joints. Real ball joints have a cone they cannot leave and real rods can touch.
